row.notes: vptr of the FFB centre spring plugin: the constructor 0x1446fb1c0 ends with lea rcx,[0x145c01040]; mov [rax],rcx after +0x30 = rcx, +0x38 = effect (rsi), lane mask +0x40 = 0, gain +0x50 = 1.0, +0x54 = 1. Slots: 0 0x144765250, 1 Update 0x1446fba30, 2 0x1446fb3e0, 3 0x144765300, 4 0x144765310, then a null qword. Update has no .pdata entry (leaf), so it is bound through this table, not as a function: (plugin, float *out_lanes, float dt) -> out_lanes; out = -clamp(vehicle+0x1c8, -1, 1) * gain plugin+0x50, broadcast and ANDed with plugin+0x40..+0x4c, vehicle = g_Sess_VehicleTable[[plugin+0x38]+0x128] when that index < g_Sess_VehicleCount, else zero lanes; dt is not read. Same plugin layout as the slip angle plugin (0x145c010d0, Car_Ffb_SlipAngleInput). Role name from the arithmetic: a force back toward 0 of vehicle+0x1c8 (not proven here to be the steering input).
